title: Equivalence of Epipelagic Data
body_html:
Equivalence of Epipelagic Data

For classical groups appearing in type I dual pairs, two epipelagic representations \[ \pi_x(\lambda,\chi),\qquad \pi_y(\lambda',\chi') \] are isomorphic exactly when their data are conjugate in the expected sense: the building points and functionals are carried to one another by \(G\), and the stabilizer characters match under the induced stabilizer isomorphism.
proof_html: The proof reduces isomorphism of compactly induced epipelagic representations to conjugacy of their unrefined minimal \(K\)-types. A lift of a stable functional is shown to be a good regular semisimple element, so its centralizer has building reduced to the relevant point. Kim-Murnaghan conjugacy of minimal \(K\)-types then forces the building points and stable functionals to match, and the stabilizer splitting epipelagic_theta.stabilizer_splitting compares the residual stabilizer characters.
